title.narrative: NGO Working Group on Women, Peace and Security 2025-2026

description.narrative:
Core contribution NGOWG for 2025-2026.
Denmark’s support for the NGO Working Group on WPS is in line with Denmark’s priority of the Women, Peace and Security agenda and promoting the participation of civil society, and the engagement will underpin Denmark’s strategic efforts in these areas while serving as an elected member of the Council in 2025-2026. The NGOWG is a coalition of 18 international NGOs with experience in every region in the world and diverse expertise grounded in decades of work promoting gender equality. Its structure as a coalition is critical to its success, allowing it to leverage the partnerships developed between its members and women peacebuilders, women human rights defenders (WHRDs), women-led organizations and women’s rights groups in conflict-affected situations.
